cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Who Cares More?
cards.instruction: Turn every favor, memory, sacrifice, and affectionate gesture into evidence that you care more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I kept twelve tickets from our trips. How many did you keep?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: None. I made you that album instead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. And I kept it. Your care is safe because of mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Open it. I put all my tickets inside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'm preserving both our collections. Let me get it a waterproof cover.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nice acceptance speech. I taught you to project, remember?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You taught me to order pizza when I was eight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And tonight an auditorium heard you. Progress.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wrote the speech myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Finally applying my lesson about not asking for help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely portrait. You're finally getting the shadows I tried to teach you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My new teacher told me to stop mixing everything with black.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You're ready to move beyond my introductory method.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She made me throw out your paint set.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. You used to be far too sentimental. I was beginning to worry I'd never get you past that.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Open it. I put all my tickets inside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'm preserving both our collections. Let me get it a waterproof cover.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll carry the heavier bag. I care more about your back.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Let me take it for a while.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you'd appear to care more about mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We could share it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only if I take the side with the books.

cards.title: Affectionate Resentment
cards.instruction: Remain warm and familiar while letting old resentment sharpen beneath every caring gesture.

beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Here's your tea, love. Exactly right, even without a birthday reminder.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've brought cake. A month late, I know.

beats.speaker: B

beats.text: Come closer, love. I'll shield the flame. We don't want it stopping halfway through like last year's birthday call.

beats.text: Then let's start with a pleasant afternoon. We can rebuild from there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can't fit everything I need to say into an afternoon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Send the rest by email. I'll read it when I'm ready, and we can keep the afternoon for us.
